ocean:
Use case: game-asset. Asset type: high-resolution seamless ocean texture for a hand-painted cozy 2D cat island game, used as a repeating background on iPad and phone. Reference image is ONLY for the hand-painted turquoise water and watercolor-like illustration style.
Create a square 2048x2048 top-down/three-quarter overhead expanse of clear turquoise tropical sea, the same cyan/turquoise and light creamy irregular wave highlights as the reference. Water ONLY, absolutely NO land, islands, dock, boats, animals, sky, horizon, text or frame. Small/medium evenly distributed delicate wave ripples and subtle refracted light. Soft hand-painted game illustration with crisp clean detailed brushwork, not photographic, not noisy, not a flat vector. Even lighting and uniform color at all edges, seamless tileable on all four edges, no central spotlight, vignette or large dramatic waves. Keep the texture calm so a separate wooden harbor and small cat raft will read clearly. Full bleed art to every edge.
harbor:
Use case: game-asset. Asset type: a single isolated transparent-background harbor-island game sprite, high resolution 2048x2048 square RGBA. Reference 1 is the established cozy hand-painted island game art style; reference 2 is the wooden dock design language.
Create one compact lush green island at the TOP RIGHT, with a chunky warm wooden pier running diagonally DOWN LEFT from its sandy rocky shore toward the CENTER LOWER LEFT. Orthographic isometric three-quarter overhead view matching the reference, clean detailed hand-painted mobile game illustration, dark warm brown outlines, soft dappled grass, a few round deciduous trees and fir trees, pale rocks, little white flowers, and a small sandy path leading onto the pier. IMPORTANT composition for animation: the open boarding end of the pier should be at approximately x=38%, y=70% of the whole square image. Pier attached to island at x=65%,y=43%. Exposed broad flat warm wood planks at boarding end, short thick cylindrical posts with beige rope on the far side. The pier's boarding tip must have a clean open unrailed lower edge so a separate cat sprite can hop to a separate raft below it. The island silhouette should fit entirely in the image, with airy transparent margins; approximate island extent x=30..94%,y=6..58%, dock extent x=16..68%,y=38..78%. Completely TRANSPARENT background outside the island and dock, no sea colored rectangle, no sky, no horizon. A tiny pale foam fringe immediately around the island shore is okay. NO cats, no animals, no rafts, no boats, no buildings, no text, no UI, no labels, no border, no drop-shadow backdrop. Full clean alpha cutout with anti-aliased edges. This sprite will move independently over a separate turquoise ocean.
